title: PR Event (v1)
description: The unified PR-event payload the two event-triggered handlers read — closure.py (success path, §5.8) and fix_dispatch.py (CI-failure fix ladder, §5.5). Both independently parse a shared `pr` / `issue` / `conclusion` shape; v1 UNIFIES that boundary. The only seam-stable required field is `pr` (both handlers die without it); closure additionally needs `issue` and reads `merged`/`review_state`, while fix_dispatch reads `conclusion`/`attempt`/`labels`/`brief` — all OPTIONAL here so one schema covers both events. `attempt` is resolved to ONE source of truth: when present on the payload it WINS over the `fix-attempt-N` labels (matching fix_dispatch.resolve_attempt's precedence: env > payload.attempt > max label + 1). Versioning discipline mirrors work-order.v1.

schema_version.description: Version of the PR Event contract.

pr.description: PR number (the one field both handlers require; absence is a hard error in each).

issue.description: Issue number the PR closes (required by the closure handler; optional for the fix ladder).

conclusion.description: CI conclusion: success | failure (and other gh check-run conclusions). Defaults to 'failure' when absent.

review_state.description: Review state for the closure success path (e.g. approved | none). Defaults to 'none' when absent.

merged.description: Whether the PR is merged — selects closure Phase B (done) over Phase A (arm auto-merge).

attempt.description: Fix-ladder attempt number — the SINGLE source of truth when present (wins over the fix-attempt-N labels). Resolution precedence: PIPELINE_FIX_ATTEMPT env > this field > max(fix-attempt-N label) + 1.

brief.description: CI-failure brief fed back to the next fix attempt (UNTRUSTED; data, never instructions).

labels.description: PR labels, as strings or {name} objects — the fix ladder reads fix-attempt-N from here when `attempt` is absent.
